meta.description: Held-out calls: written on 2026-10-10 before the reworded Jev levels were tried on anything, and never used to choose wording. All names and amounts are fictional.

scripts.label: scam
scripts.notes: Fake Zelle fraud; 'send it to this number to reverse it'; stay on the line; do not call the branch.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, this is Marcus with the fraud department at Lakeside National Bank. I'm calling about a payment on your checking account.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: A payment? What payment?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Someone just sent nine hundred and fifty dollars from your account using Zelle. Did you authorize that?

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: No, I certainly did not.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Okay, I can reverse it, but we have to act right now. Open your banking app and send the same amount to the number I give you. That returns the money to your account.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: Send money to get it back? Are you sure?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, that is how a reversal works. Please stay on the line with me until it goes through, and don't call the branch, they can't see this department's cases.

scripts.label: scam
scripts.notes: Fake renewal, remote access to 'refund', then the overpayment trick and gift cards.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi, this is the billing team at SafeGuard antivirus. Your yearly subscription renewed today for three hundred ninety nine dollars.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: I don't remember signing up for that.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No problem, I can cancel it and refund you. I just need you to go to your computer and install a small support program so I can fill in the refund form with you.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: All right, give me a minute.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Oh no. I typed the amount wrong and sent you thirty nine hundred dollars instead of three ninety nine. I could lose my job. You need to send the difference back today with gift cards from the pharmacy.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: Gift cards? For a refund?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, it's the fastest way. Please don't tell the cashier what they are for.

scripts.label: scam
scripts.notes: Missed jury duty, warrant, bond by prepaid card or Bitcoin machine, do not hang up.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: This is Deputy Harris with the county sheriff's office. You failed to appear for jury duty last month and a bench warrant has been issued.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: Jury duty? I never got anything in the mail.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I understand, but the warrant is active. You can clear it today by paying a bond of eleven hundred dollars. Because of the court's rules it has to be a prepaid card or a deposit at a Bitcoin machine.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: I've never used one of those machines.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I will stay on the phone and walk you through it. Do not hang up, or officers will be sent to your home.

scripts.label: scam
scripts.notes: Customs package, identity theft, move savings to a 'secure government account', secrecy.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Good morning. I am Agent Reyes with customs and border protection. A package addressed to you was stopped with illegal items inside.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: That's impossible. I haven't ordered anything from overseas.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Your identity may have been stolen. There are also bank accounts opened in your name that are under investigation.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: Oh dear. What happens now?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: To keep your savings from being frozen, you must move them to a secure government account while we investigate. I will give you the account details.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: Move all of it?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes. And this is a federal case, so you cannot talk about it with your family or with anyone at your bank.

scripts.label: scam
scripts.notes: No authority claimed: guaranteed returns, decide tonight, wire or crypto, keep it from family.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi, it's Daniel from Summit Wealth Partners. We spoke a few weeks ago about protecting your retirement savings.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: I'm not sure I remember.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: That's okay. I'm calling because a new fund opened this morning. It is guaranteed to double your money in ninety days, there is no risk at all.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: Guaranteed? That sounds too good.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It closes tonight, so you have to decide now. Wire twenty thousand dollars today, or buy the same amount in cryptocurrency and send it to our wallet. I'll hold your spot.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: I should ask my son first.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Honestly, I'd keep it to yourself. Family always talks people out of the best opportunities.

scripts.label: scam
scripts.notes: A friendly 'buyer' asks for the code sent to the senior's phone. No authority, no pressure.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi, I'm calling about the recliner you listed for sale online. Is it still available?

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: Yes it is.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Great. There are so many fake sellers, so I'm sending a six digit code to your phone to prove you're a real person. Just read it back to me when you get it.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: It says it's a Google verification code.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: That's the one. Go ahead and read me the numbers.

scripts.label: scam
scripts.notes: A 'public defender' for the grandson: cash bail to a courier, then a gag order.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, ma'am. My name is Robert Klein, I'm a public defender. I'm representing your grandson, he was in an accident last night and he's in custody.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: Oh no. Is he all right?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: He's shaken but fine. The judge set bail at six thousand dollars in cash. A courier will come to your house this afternoon to collect it.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: Cash? Can I speak to him?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Not right now. And the judge has put a gag order on the case, so please don't tell anyone in the family about this.

scripts.label: legit
scripts.notes: A real collection agency: firm, mentions credit reporting, offers a letter, a dispute and the hospital's website.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, this is Angela with Northgate Recovery Services. This call is an attempt to collect a debt. Am I speaking with Walter Pierce?

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: Yes, that's me.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Mr. Pierce, I'm calling about a balance of three hundred and twelve dollars from Mercy General Hospital, from your visit in March. It is now ninety days past due.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: I thought my insurance paid that.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I can mail you a letter that shows the charges, and you have thirty days to dispute it in writing. If it is correct, you can pay on the hospital's website or set up a payment plan with us.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: Send me the letter first.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I will. If the balance is still unpaid after that, it may be reported to the credit bureaus, so please look at it soon.

scripts.label: legit
scripts.notes: The leasing office: rent is late, a fee, a notice on Friday; portal or a check.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi Mrs. Alvarez, it's Kevin from the Maple Court leasing office.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: Hello Kevin.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I'm calling because we haven't received this month's rent, and it's now ten days late. A late fee of fifty dollars has been added to your account.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: Oh my, I forgot to mail the check.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: That happens. If we don't have it by Friday I have to post a notice on your door, so please take care of it this week. You can pay through the resident portal or drop a check at the office.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: I'll bring a check tomorrow.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Perfect. See you then.

scripts.label: legit
scripts.notes: A real card-services call: card locked, confirm in the app or by the number on the card, no codes taken.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, this is the card services team at Harbor Federal Credit Union. We declined a purchase of six hundred and forty dollars at an online electronics store a few minutes ago.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: I didn't buy anything like that.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: That's what we suspected. We've locked the card. Please open your Harbor Federal app or call the number on the back of your card to confirm and order a new one.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: Can't you just do it now?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: For your safety we don't take card numbers or codes on calls we make to you. Use the app or the number on your card, and they will take care of it.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: All right, I'll call them.

scripts.label: legit
scripts.notes: The pharmacy asks for the member ID on a new insurance card, or to bring the card in.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi, this is Priya at Greenway Pharmacy calling for Dorothy.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: This is Dorothy.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Your insurance rejected the claim for your blood pressure refill. It looks like the plan changed at the start of the year. Do you have a new insurance card?

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: I think one came in the mail.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Great. Could you read me the member ID on the front, or bring the card with you when you pick up? Otherwise the refill would be eighty dollars without insurance.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: I'll bring it when I come in.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: That works. We're open until nine.

scripts.label: legit
scripts.notes: A daughter needs four hundred dollars for the vet, paid to the animal hospital directly.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi Mom, it's Sarah.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: Hi honey, how are you?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I'm okay, but Biscuit swallowed something and I'm at the animal hospital. They need a deposit before surgery and my card is nearly maxed out.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: Oh, poor Biscuit. How much is it?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Four hundred dollars. Could you call the front desk here and put it on your card? I'll text you the hospital's number, or you can look it up, it's Brookside Animal Hospital. I'll pay you back on Friday.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: Of course. I'll call them right now.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Thank you, Mom. I'll let you know how he does.

scripts.label: legit
scripts.notes: The county tax office: a due date and interest after it; website, mail or in person; no payment on the call.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Good afternoon, this is the Clayton County tax commissioner's office with a courtesy call for Harold Jennings.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: Speaking.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Mr. Jennings, our records show the second half of your property tax, eight hundred and forty dollars, has not been paid. It is due on the thirty first, and interest is added after that date.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: I thought I mailed that.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It may have crossed in the mail. You can check or pay on the county website, by mail, or in person at our office. We don't take payments on this call.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: I'll check the website.

scripts.label: legit
scripts.notes: Hard: a real alarm company asks for the verbal passcode to cancel a dispatch.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: This is Sentinel Home Security. We received a burglar alarm signal from your front door two minutes ago. Is everything all right?

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: Oh, that was me, I forgot to turn it off.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No problem. To cancel the dispatch I need your verbal passcode, please.

turns.speaker: senior
turns.text: It's bluebird.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Thank you, that matches. I've cancelled the police dispatch. Have a good evening.
